description: Answers an offer in a conversation about an item: the seller accepts, declines or counters a buyer's offer (a counter is between the offer and the price); the buyer accepts or declines the seller's counter. Accepting lets the buyer buy at that price within 24 hours. Only what the person decided. Needs sign-in.

as.description: Only when the person is both buyer and seller (a test): which side to act as.

counter.description: The seller only, with answer counter: the price they'd take, in the item's currency.

counter_aud.description: Older name for counter, in Australian dollars. Use counter.

name: answer_offer
title: Answer an offer
